kbdevFeatures.title: Knows when a service actually died
kbdevFeatures.detail: Tracks real PIDs because it spawned the processes. No port scanning, no stale state.

kbdevFeatures.title: Doesn't call it alive until it responds
kbdevFeatures.detail: HTTP, TCP, and command health probes with latency. Reports alive only after the check passes.

kbdevFeatures.title: Starts in the right order
kbdevFeatures.detail: Reads service dependencies from devservices.yaml and starts in topological order automatically.

page.kbdevMetaDesc: One binary that starts services in the right order, waits until they're actually up, and shuts everything down cleanly on exit.

kbdevCommands.desc: Start all services in dependency order. Health-probes before reporting alive.
Show running state, PID, port, and uptime per service.
Restart a specific service by name.
Stream live logs for a service. Ctrl-C to stop.
Run environment diagnostics: ports, deps, config, health.

page.kbdevHeroDescription: One binary that starts services in the right order, waits until they're actually up, and shuts everything down cleanly on exit.
page.kbdevConfigLead1: Drop devservices.yaml in the project root — kb-dev finds it automatically by walking up from the current directory.
page.kbdevConfigLead2: Works with any stack: Docker, pnpm, npm, make, shell. KB Labs uses .kb/devservices.yaml — same format.
page.kbdevCommandsFootnote: All commands support --json for scripts and CI
